lines: (even if you never miss a shake)
cover.sub: Number 5 is the one almost every lifter falls for.

reasons.head: You think your body can only use 30g at once
reasons.sub: In one study, the body kept using protein from a big meal for hours, with no clear upper limit.

reasons.head: You think timing matters most
reasons.sub: In one study, protein before or after training gave the same results, so don't stress the clock.

reasons.head: You think plant protein can't build muscle
reasons.sub: A review found soy protein built as much strength and muscle as whey and other animal protein.

reasons.head: You think protein will wreck your kidneys
reasons.sub: A review of 28 studies found no sign that high-protein diets harm healthy kidneys.

reasons.head: You guess how much protein you eat
reasons.sub: Without adding it up, you can't tell if you hit your target or fell way short.
